ReviewedContracts: CompareSnapshot preserves one ref NodeComparisonContext across every queued child and callers that reuse it across map sorting.
LIFO continuation stack resumes the current sequence only after the complete yielded child; lazy scalar results retain the old short-circuit ordering.
Tuples compare count before elements; native records preserve module/name/export/count/all field names exact then values; maps preserve count/all exact keys then values under caller exactness.
External/local function identity order and captured environment exactness remain unchanged; cons loop compares heads then final improper/proper tail without CLR recursive descent.

Hash frames preserve scalar GetHashCode inputs and old HashCode.Add(Term) child hash contribution through Add(int); same-process HashCode.Combine of child integers preserves map pair fold and unchecked sum.
Cons hash retains flattened tails; frame accumulator is a mutable field on a reference object, and per-map key/pair accumulators are isolated per frame.
Current hash and comparison enumerators are disposed on early result and exception; no per-call memoization or all-siblings push changes identity or wide-term storage policy.
Harness constructs independent left/right/greater terms and prints loaded Terms DLL hash plus flushed CONSTRUCTED before deep operation; shallow independent old fold uses same process random seed.
Snapshot reflection carries the updated byref context between invocations and tests fresh-context visibility after identity publication; no production test hook is added.
Child capture validates finite32768 depth/60s maximum, starts no shell/descendants, joins direct child on normal exit/timeout/finally, and reports capture rather than semantic success.
ScopeLimits: No SDK/style/build or managed child has been run by this review. Source risk is not a reproduced stack overflow.
First execution requires separately preserved red baseline and green candidate binaries/source hashes; classify failure from checkpoint/stderr/exit, not nonzero exit alone.

Controller records capture-only and returns zero even when child fails. Any PASS/red classification must inspect receipt and raw output; loaded DLL stdout identity must be checked against selected immutable binary.
Normal supported term objects contain non-null Term children; malformed host-only null child graphs are outside this source gate.
Portable five original cases are source-derived and unexecuted; native-record/signed-zero breadth, cooperative scheduling/cancellation and performance are not proven.
Internal HashCode preservation does not constitute erlang phash algorithm or stable numeric hash compatibility.
